feature_location.position: after img_in linear projection; before positional embedding use and before every attention/transformer block
feature_location.mapping: row-major generated-image tokens with explicit img_ids; no reference tokens

band_policy.transform: orthonormal 2D DCT independently for every hidden channel over the 32x32 token grid
band_policy.mask: high-pass source substitution where u+v>3; generated coefficients retained where u+v<=3
band_policy.rationale: The official high-FBS default used for contour preservation and appearance divergence is threshold 3. The exact absolute threshold is retained as a falsifier, not claimed scale-equivalent to SD1.5 64x64 latents.

trajectory_policy.reference: Native Klein source-img2img Euler trajectory with the same Gaussian endpoint and empty conditioning at CFG 1.0.
trajectory_policy.generation: Native target-prompt source-img2img Euler trajectory with the same Gaussian endpoint.
trajectory_policy.synchronization: Precompute and capture reference post_input features at every identical sigma evaluation; transfer from the same ordinal/sigma into generation.

portrait_bronze.prompt: The same woman with the same facial identity, expression, head pose, hairstyle silhouette, and portrait framing, transformed into a highly detailed aged bronze statue with oxidized turquoise patina, dramatic museum spot lighting, dark gallery atmosphere

astronaut_steampunk.prompt: The same full-body astronaut in exactly the same stance and proportions, transformed into an ornate steampunk brass exploration suit with copper pipes and weathered metal, standing in a bioluminescent alien jungle at night, cinematic lighting

bridge_crystal_night.prompt: The same suspension bridge and train with exactly the same perspective, tower positions, deck line, cables, and composition, transformed into luminous crystalline architecture at night with glowing glass surfaces, deep blue water, dramatic reflections

visual_assessment.portrait_bronze: FAIL: substantial bronze/statue change occurs, but facial identity, apparent age, arm pose, body framing, and placement are not preserved over either control.
visual_assessment.astronaut_steampunk: FAIL: the feature arm changes face visibility/identity, suit silhouette, proportions, and stance; it does not preserve geometry better than FSS.
visual_assessment.bridge_crystal_night: FAIL: the feature arm constructs a different bridge/tower system and perspective rather than preserving source contours.
visual_assessment.decisive_interpretation: The preregistered internal post-input high band has no useful identity/geometry advantage over FSS and is unstable under global transformer mixing.
